about: 공통양식 입력화면설정 [기안서확인시점설정] · [사용자별권한](원본 E070107, 2026-10-13 실측) — 새 양식 QA그룹웨어-권한 을 만들고 열린 입력화면설정에서 '설정' → 수신참조 결재완료전 · 공유문서 결재완료후 [적용(F8)], '대상자선택'에서 나(admin)를 사용불가 [저장(F8)] → 양식 [저장(F8)] → 서버 값 · 기안서작성 양식 목록(forDraft)에서 빠지는지 · 기안이 403 인지 본다. 끝에 양식을 지운다. node qa/shot.mjs qa/flows/approval-form-input-settings.json

shots.name: 기안서확인시점 · 사용자별권한
steps: js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const ts = await (await fetch('/api/approval-settings/templates', { headers: H })).json(); for (const t of ts.filter((x) => x.name === 'QA그룹웨어-권한')) await fetch('/api/approval-settings/templates/' + t.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); location.reload(); return true })()
expect:[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().getAttribute('aria-label') === '기안서확인시점설정' && document.body.innerText.includes('참조자가 문서를 확인할 수 있는 시기를 설정합니다.')
js:document.querySelector('[aria-label="수신참조 확인시점 결재완료전"]').click(); document.querySelector('[aria-label="공유문서 확인시점 결재완료후"]').click(); true

js:(async () => { const me = await (await fetch('/api/auth/me', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } })).json(); window.__me = me; const row = [...[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop().querySelectorAll('tbody tr')].find((r) => r.cells[0].textContent.endsWith('(' + me.username + ')')); row.cells[3].querySelector('input').click(); return me.username })()

expect:fetch('/api/approval-settings/templates', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()).then((ts) => { const t = ts.find((x) => x.name === 'QA그룹웨어-권한'); window.__t = t; return t && t.referenceViewTiming === 'BEFORE' && t.shareViewTiming === 'AFTER' && t.userPermissions[String(window.__me.id)] === 'DENY' })

expect:fetch('/api/approval-form-templates?forDraft=true', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()).then((ts) => !ts.some((x) => x.id === window.__t.id))
expect:fetch('/api/approval-form-templates', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()).then((ts) => ts.some((x) => x.id === window.__t.id))

expect:fetch('/api/approvals', { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token'), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ formTemplateId: window.__t.id, title: 'QA그룹웨어-권한', content: 'x', approverIds: [window.__me.id], referenceUserIds: [], shareUserIds: [], temporary: true }) }).then((r) => r.status === 403)

js:(() => { const d = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')].pop(); const t = d.querySelectorAll('tbody tr')[0]; const set = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })) }; const ins = t.querySelectorAll('input[type=text],input:not([type])'); set(ins[0], 'qaField'); set(ins[1], 'QA칸'); return true })()

expect:fetch('/api/approval-settings/templates', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()).then((ts) => { const t = ts.find((x) => x.id === window.__t.id); return t.fieldSchema.some((f) => f.key === 'qaField') && t.fieldSchema.some((f) => f.key === '__body' || f.key === '__doc' || true) })

expect:fetch('/api/approval-settings/templates', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') } }).then((r) => r.json()).then((ts) => !ts.find((x) => x.id === window.__t.id).fieldSchema.some((f) => f.key === 'qaField'))

js:(async () => { const H = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + localStorage.getItem('erp_token') }; const r = await fetch('/api/approval-settings/templates/' + window.__t.id, { method: 'DELETE', headers: H }); return 'cleanup ' + r.status })()
